critical_code_review_comments: server.py:723 GET /api/health is genuinely secret-free — only status/build/time/sms_provider/provider_check/provider_message/provider_checked_at/demo_mode are returned. No authkey/template_id keys. Good.
server.py:767 authkey_hint correctly exposes only the last 4 chars prefixed with '…'. Verified '…f3P1' returned to admin.
server.py:782 sms_test refuses demo phones with an explicit message BEFORE any MSG91 call — prevents accidental paid sends during QA. Verified via curl and via SmsDiagnostics UI.

server.py:796 sms_recheck short-circuits when status != 'accepted' (returns the entry as-is instead of hitting the log API) — sound. For accepted entries the /report/logs/p/sms lookup is invoked and mapped into delivery_status/delivery_detail.

server.py:723-799 (SMS block) is a self-contained ~80-line module inside a 3107-line server.py. server.py continues to exceed the 700-line guideline; consider extracting `routers/sms_diagnostics.py`. Not blocking.
SmsDiagnostics.tsx line 190: SEND TEST is disabled when !ok — but also disabled during `testing || phone.length !== 10`. That prevents users typing invalid numbers from clicking. Good UX.
SmsDiagnostics.tsx line 82: scheduleRefresh chains three setTimeout at +8/+24/+66s to align with backend delivery re-checks at +6/+20/+60s — matches server-side DELIVERY_CHECK_DELAYS. Clean.

panel.tsx line 1326 correctly gates SmsDiagnostics with `tab==='sms' && role==='admin'`, and line 429-445 correctly restricts ADMIN_TABS to admin only (executive/billing don't see the tab at all). Verified end-to-end.

In-memory _msg91_preflight cache (5 min) is process-local; a multi-worker deployment could show stale/misaligned validation but this is acceptable given the failure mode (worst case: 1 stale preflight per worker per 5 min).
seed_data_creation: No new customer/product/rewards data created. Test executed a recheck on the first existing 'accepted' sms_log entry — this appends one entry to that log's `checks` array and updates `last_checked_at`. No delivery status was flipped (existing entries stayed 'delivered').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build 2026.09.04-sms-v4 verified end-to-end. Health check now provider-validated so ANY MSG91 config drift will surface immediately at /api/health (provider_check flips to 'FAILED' + provider_message carries the reason). Admin panel SMS tab testIDs: sms-diagnostics, sms-provider-status ('PROVIDER OK'/'PROVIDER FAILED'), sms-provider-message, sms-recheck-provider, sms-test-phone, sms-test-send (disabled unless 10 digits AND provider ok), sms-refresh-list, sms-row-<id>, sms-recheck-<id>, sms-retry (only shown if diagnostics load failed). SEND TEST on web uses window.alert — attach page.on('dialog', ...) BEFORE clicking. Role guards on /panel enforced client-side by conditional tab arrays AND server-side by 403 on the endpoints; both verified. panelLogout redirects to /login (customer app), not back to /panel — testing script must re-navigate to /panel between role switches.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is a feature-verification pass on the SMS diagnostics build. Original 'OTP said sent but no SMS' RCA (MSG91 /flow returning type=success on invalid authkey/template) is fully mitigated: (1) every real send is now preceded by a live authkey+template preflight (cached 5 min) that raises HTTP 503 on misconfig BEFORE storing the OTP challenge, so users no longer see 'OTP sent successfully' when MSG91 will silently drop it; (2) every accepted send is logged and reconciled against MSG91's /report/logs/p/sms at +6s/+20s/+60s, exposing dropped/failed statuses in the admin panel; (3) /api/health surfaces provider health publicly so uptime tooling can catch drift. Backend and admin UI both verified to enforce the new contract.
